One cylinder, drawn from your engine's live numbers. Slowed down so you can follow a full cycle. Click a numbered dot to jump to the setting that controls it.

What you are seeing

Try this

  • Switch to the virtual copy and drag the throttle: watch the plenum fill, then add boost and see the pressure peak climb.
  • Open Ignition main, add a few degrees, and come back: the spark marker and the pressure peak move.
  • Pause and drag the crank angle to follow one cycle: intake, compression, power, exhaust.
  • Convert to E85 and watch the spray, flame color and pressure change.
